purpose: Choose a storage-neutral L4 link-backend boundary that can preserve the existing AnumMemory observable semantics while allowing persistent/high-performance implementations such as a future PMM adapter.

identityLayers.name: L4-adapter-logical-ref
identityLayers.scope: one opened logical memory view/session unless a stronger capability is declared

models.name: fat-backend-knows-anum-and-mts
models.reason: Duplicates L2/L3 semantics inside storage and creates a second parser/denotation path.

models.name: opaque-exact-pair-link-backend-with-atomic-write-capability
models.reason: Keeps storage responsible only for canonical links and indices while an L4 adapter resolves typed denotation and controls explicit effects.
bootstrapSurface: import_closed_graph(...), or backend-specific equivalent outside normal realize
models.atomicWriteCapability: native transaction or atomic batch commit sufficient to prevent partial multi-link denotation realization

models.name: link-primitives-without-atomic-multi-write-boundary
models.reason: A multi-node AnumDenotation could become partially visible after failure, violating the accepted all-or-nothing reference behavior.

models.name: physical-address-is-logical-link-identity
models.reason: Would make allocator/storage layout part of MTS ontology and prevent backend-independent conformance.

observableSemantics.exactPairUniqueness: within one logical memory state, an ordered (start,end) pair has at most one logical Link identity
observableSemantics.realizeLink: idempotent: return existing logical link for exact pair or create exactly one
observableSemantics.findLink: read-only exact ordered-pair lookup; never creates
observableSemantics.poles: returns exact ordered start/end logical refs
observableSemantics.outgoingIncoming: read-only incidence lookup; ordering is not semantic and conformance normalizes as sets
observableSemantics.delete: delete exactly one link; reject while another link references it; no implicit cascade
observableSemantics.bootstrapCycles: closed cyclic seed graphs may be imported through an explicit bootstrap path; ordinary realize does not invent unresolved endpoints
observableSemantics.multiNodeRealize: adapter-level realization of one validated StructuralDenotation is atomic and idempotent
observableSemantics.errorAtomicity: missing anchors, invalid handles, or backend failure must not expose a partially realized denotation

conformanceNormalization.symbolicBindings: scenario names bind returned opaque logical refs and later operations refer to those names

persistenceRequirements.interruptedWrite: if backend exposes crash recovery, recovery must reveal either the committed pre-state or committed post-state, never a half-realized denotation

requiredVectors: same normalized topology with different opaque handle values
backend adapter surface contains no raw parser or L2 interpreter
persistent adapter clean reopen and exact-pair uniqueness
persistent adapter interrupted-write recovery where supported

releaseGate: pass backend-neutral challenge against the current in-memory reference adapter
run the same language-neutral observable corpus against at least one persistent adapter
prove topology/results match after handle normalization
accept a versioned backend contract before making PMM or another backend canonical
